decisions.reason: It is distant from the firm's maritime core and stated strategic direction, and with no visible success signal beyond continued listing, management would have reason to reallocate resources despite having slack.
It builds on established crewing capabilities and stayed on the website through 2024, so for an expanding firm it likely meets a minimum aspiration even without standout public results.
Rapidly building a six-institution partner network soon after launch is a strong early outcome for a core-related education offer and gives little reason to search for alternatives.
Successfully transferring all required FuelEU monitoring plans before the deadline indicates the service is performing satisfactorily in a strategically important regulatory area.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's ship-management software and fits its digitalisation and environmental strategy, so management is likely to retain it while demand develops.

The cost simulation tool strengthens the same emissions-compliance software stack and can be carried by the firm's slack, although its standalone payoff is slightly more uncertain than the related service offerings.
